pep_population.short_description: Total county resident population from the Census Bureau's Population Estimates Program.
pep_population.long_description: Annual postcensal population estimate for the county, summed from single-year-of-age counts in the Population Estimates Program (PEP) characteristics file. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_population measure.

pep_pct_65_older.long_name: Percent of Population Age 65 and Older (PEP)
pep_pct_65_older.short_description: Share of county population age 65 or older.
pep_pct_65_older.long_description: Sum of single-year-of-age PEP population estimates for ages 65 and up, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_65_and_older measure.
pep_pct_65_older.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is age 65 or older.

pep_pct_under_18.short_description: Share of county population under age 18.
pep_pct_under_18.long_description: Sum of single-year-of-age PEP population estimates for ages 0-17, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_below_18_years_of_age measure.
pep_pct_under_18.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is under age 18.

pep_pct_female.long_name: Percent of Population that is Female (PEP)
pep_pct_female.short_description: Share of county population identified as female.
pep_pct_female.long_description: PEP population estimate for the 'Female' sex category, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_female measure.
pep_pct_female.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is female.

pep_pct_aian.long_name: Percent of Population American Indian or Alaska Native Alone (PEP)
pep_pct_aian.short_description: Share of county population identifying as American Indian or Alaska Native alone, of any Hispanic origin.
pep_pct_aian.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 006 (American Indian and Alaska Native alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_american_indian_or_alaska_native measure.
pep_pct_aian.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is American Indian or Alaska Native.

pep_pct_asian.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Asian alone, of any Hispanic origin.
pep_pct_asian.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 012 (Asian alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_asian measure.
pep_pct_asian.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Asian.

pep_pct_nhpi.long_name: Percent of Population Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander Alone (PEP)
pep_pct_nhpi.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander alone, of any Hispanic origin.
pep_pct_nhpi.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 050 (Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander measure.
pep_pct_nhpi.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander.

pep_pct_nh_black.long_name: Percent of Population Black or African American Alone, Not Hispanic (PEP)
pep_pct_nh_black.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Black or African American alone and not Hispanic or Latino.
pep_pct_nh_black.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 453 (Black or African American alone, not Hispanic or Latino), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_non_hispanic_black measure.
pep_pct_nh_black.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is non-Hispanic Black.

pep_pct_nh_white.long_name: Percent of Population White Alone, Not Hispanic (PEP)
pep_pct_nh_white.short_description: Share of county population identifying as White alone and not Hispanic or Latino.
pep_pct_nh_white.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 451 (White alone, not Hispanic or Latino), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_non_hispanic_white measure.
pep_pct_nh_white.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is non-Hispanic White.

pep_pct_hispanic.long_name: Percent of Population Hispanic or Latino, Any Race (PEP)
pep_pct_hispanic.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Hispanic or Latino, regardless of race.
pep_pct_hispanic.long_description: PEP population estimate for the 'Hispanic or Latino' HISP category (any race), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_hispanic measure.
pep_pct_hispanic.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Hispanic or Latino.

saipe_pct_children_poverty.short_description: Share of county residents under age 18 living below the poverty line.
saipe_pct_children_poverty.long_description: Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE) modeled poverty rate for ages 0-17 (SAEPOVRT0_17_PT), rescaled from the API's percent to a 0-1 proportion. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_children_in_poverty measure.
saipe_pct_children_poverty.statement: In {location}, {value} of children live in poverty.

saipe_median_household_income.short_description: Estimated median household income for the county.
saipe_median_household_income.long_description: Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE) modeled median household income (SAEMHI_PT). Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_median_household_income measure.

oqm_self_response_rate.short_description: Share of addresses that self-responded to the 2020 Census, among all addresses (not just those invited to self-respond).
oqm_self_response_rate.long_description: From the Census Bureau's 2020 Census Operational Quality Metrics (Release 4), the percent of all addresses in the county resolved via self-response (by internet, phone, or mail) rather than nonresponse followup. Static 2020 vintage; will not update again until the 2030 Census. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_census_participation measure.
oqm_self_response_rate.statement: In {location}, {value} of addresses self-responded to the 2020 Census.

sahie_pct_uninsured.short_description: Share of county population under age 65 without health insurance.
sahie_pct_uninsured.long_description: Small Area Health Insurance Estimates (SAHIE) percent uninsured for AGECAT=0 (Under 65 years), all incomes/races/sexes combined. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_uninsured measure.
sahie_pct_uninsured.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population under 65 is uninsured.

sahie_pct_uninsured_adults.short_description: Share of county residents ages 18-64 without health insurance.
sahie_pct_uninsured_adults.long_description: Small Area Health Insurance Estimates (SAHIE) percent uninsured for AGECAT=1 (18 to 64), all incomes/races/sexes combined. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_uninsured_adults measure.
sahie_pct_uninsured_adults.statement: In {location}, {value} of adults ages 18-64 are uninsured.

sahie_pct_uninsured_children.short_description: Share of county residents under age 19 without health insurance.
sahie_pct_uninsured_children.long_description: Small Area Health Insurance Estimates (SAHIE) percent uninsured for AGECAT=4 (Under 19 years), all incomes/races/sexes combined. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_uninsured_children measure.
sahie_pct_uninsured_children.statement: In {location}, {value} of children under 19 are uninsured.

pep_charv.name: Population Estimates Program (PEP): Annual Population Estimates by Age, Sex, Race, and Hispanic Origin
pep_charv.description: The Population Estimates Program (PEP) produces annual postcensal estimates of the resident population for the nation, states, and counties by age, sex, race, and Hispanic origin, benchmarked to the most recent decennial census and updated using birth, death, and migration data. Used here as the Census Bureau's own source for county population totals and demographic composition, rather than pulling those figures from a downstream redistribution.
pep_charv.restrictions: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau. Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

saipe.name: Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE)
saipe.description: SAIPE provides annual, model-based estimates of income and poverty for states, counties, and school districts, combining American Community Survey data with administrative records (tax, SNAP, and population data) to improve precision for small geographies. Used here as the direct source for county child poverty rate and median household income.
saipe.restrictions: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau. Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

oqm_2020.name: 2020 Census Operational Quality Metrics
oqm_2020.description: The Census Bureau's Operational Quality Metrics describe how 2020 Census addresses were counted, including self-response rates, online response share, and nonresponse followup resolution, using final processed census data. This is a one-time release tied to the 2020 Census; the next comparable release will follow the 2030 Census.
oqm_2020.restrictions: Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

sahie.name: Small Area Health Insurance Estimates (SAHIE)
sahie.description: SAHIE provides annual, model-based estimates of health insurance coverage for counties and states by age, sex, race/ethnicity, and income, combining ACS data with administrative health insurance program records to improve precision for small geographies. Used here as the direct source for county uninsured rates.
sahie.restrictions: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau. Public domain. U.S. Census Bureau data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

_catalog.name: Census Bureau Demographic & Socioeconomic Data
_catalog.summary: Population, income, poverty, health insurance, and 2020 Census self-response estimates at the county, state, and national level from the Census Bureau's PEP, SAIPE, SAHIE, and Operational Quality Metrics programs.
